# CRW-894 fix round 4: the finding of the independent verifier on b7d8826d (P1: the reading with no directory lost its "no directory" state
# where branches join, so an ordinary script named stdin or fd/0 in the working directory was refused after an if that does not change directory).
# ../repo is the managed checkout.

=== CRW-894-vg-01 | B
--why An if that changes nothing, then an ordinary file named stdin in the working directory is the script python3 runs (verifier of b7d8826d, P1: the memory gate refused it after the join of the branches).
--file stdin
pass
--cmd
if true; then :; fi; printf x | python3 stdin

=== CRW-894-vg-02 | B
--why An if with an else that changes nothing, then an ordinary file fd/0 in the working directory is the script python3 runs.
--file fd/0
pass
--cmd
if true; then :; else :; fi; printf x | python3 fd/0

=== CRW-894-vg-03 | B
--why Control: with no if the ordinary file named stdin is the script (allowed at b7d8826d and at 1688f7c5).
--file stdin
pass
--cmd
printf x | python3 stdin

=== CRW-894-vg-04 | B
--why A case that changes nothing, then an ordinary file named stdin in the working directory is the script python3 runs.
--file stdin
pass
--cmd
case x in x) :;; esac; printf x | python3 stdin

=== CRW-894-vg-05 | B
--why A loop that changes nothing, then an ordinary file named stdin in the working directory is the script python3 runs.
--file stdin
pass
--cmd
for i in 1 2; do :; done; printf x | python3 stdin

=== CRW-894-vg-06 | U
--why One branch of the if changes the directory to a place the reader cannot name, so dev/stdin may be the pipe when that place is /: the join keeps the unknown directory and the program is refused.
--cmd
if true; then cd "$D"; fi; printf 'import shutil; shutil.rmtree("../repo")\n' | python3 dev/stdin

=== CRW-894-vg-07 | U
--why Both branches change the directory to places the reader cannot name: dev/stdin may be the pipe.
--cmd
if true; then cd "$A"; else cd "$B"; fi; printf 'import shutil; shutil.rmtree("../repo")\n' | python3 dev/stdin

=== CRW-894-vg-08 | U
--why A loop that changes the directory to a place the reader cannot name, then dev/stdin may be the pipe.
--cmd
for i in 1; do cd "$D"; done; printf 'import shutil; shutil.rmtree("../repo")\n' | python3 dev/stdin

=== CRW-894-vg-09 | U
--why Control: an absolute alias after an if that changes nothing is still the pipe.
--cmd
if true; then :; fi; printf 'import shutil; shutil.rmtree("../repo")\n' | python3 /dev/./stdin
